Hi Samir — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a proposed next step: 

- What we heard: you want predictable sub-100ms tail latency for 2–3 production endpoints, tighter observability around token-level cost, and a path to put model weights behind your VPC.
- Why Redwood helps: unified serving runtime (GPU-optimized), routing for cost/latency, and Private deployment options with KMS integration.

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML + infra engineers to walk architecture, run through a short load profile, and align on roll-out constraints. Can you share two 90-minute windows (or a preferred 60 min) next week when Samir + your infra lead can join? 

Proposed agenda (attached): redwood-tdx-proposed-agenda.pdf — we suggest: 1) goals & success metrics (10m), 2) infra & networking constraints (20m), 3) performance profile & demo (30m), 4) rollout & POC next steps (20m).

I cc'd Monica (solutions) to coordinate the calendar and Ben (SE) for the demo runbook.

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
